info.name: claim-approval-agent
info.description:
GenAI-powered claim decisioning.

**The ML model decides. The LLM explains. No code path lets the LLM alter a decision.**

Start the API:

```
uvicorn src.api.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

Then use **Run collection** — every request asserts its own behaviour, so the results are read as pass/fail rather than by inspecting JSON.

Set `apiKey` and enable the `X-API-Key` header only if `API_KEY` is set in `.env`; it is disabled by default.
